messages:
maria: Quick weekend check 1 1 low-effort plans: 1) sunset bike along the boardwalk + tacos, 2) ridge viewpoint hike (quick loop), 3) indoor potluck if it pours. Who's up? :sun_with_face: :bike:
ajay: Boardwalk and tacos for me. Ill bring a small bluetooth speaker and some hot sauce. :fire:
sam: Id prefer the hike but can only do an early start (7am). Will the ridge trail be muddy?
liz: Im down for potluck as a backup. Can bring kimchi pancakes (veg) if needed. :yum:
ben: Boardwalk tacos sound perfect. 6pm OK?
tasha: @sam the ridge drains pretty well; the steep bit was fine last weekend. Trail map: https://maps.example/trails/ridgeview
ops-bot: Heads up: team picnic rules  no glass containers, please pack out all trash.
maria: Plan: meet at west entrance (near Pier 4) Sat 6pm. If Fri 3pm forecast looks bad we pivot to potluck at my place. RSVP: react with :thumbsup: for boardwalk, :house: for potluck, :hiking_boot: for hike.
ajay: :thumbsup:
sam: :hiking_boot: (only early morning for me)
liz: :thumbsup: (ill message if we switch to potluck and what to bring)
ben: :thumbsup: also can someone bring napkins pls lol
tasha: :thumbsup: ill bring compostable plates
maria: Awesome. I have a couple of bike locks if anyone needs one. Bringing a cooler + extra salsa. See you Saturday! :taco: :bike: :sunset:
